“Bezalel and Oholiab shall work with every wise-hearted man, in whom Yahweh has put wisdom and understanding to know…
Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.

parallels.note: Hur became the father of Uri, and Uri became the father of Bezalel.

people.name: Bezalel
people.line: Skilled craftsman who built the tabernacle

people.name: Hur
people.line: A companion of Moses and grandfather of Bezalel.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

people.name: Uri
people.line: Father of Bezalel, the skilled craftsman

translations.web: Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that Yahweh commanded Moses.
translations.bsb: Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made everything that the LORD had commanded Moses.
translations.kjv: And Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.
translations.asv: And Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that Jehovah commanded Moses.
